proposal.reasoning: Selected a 100 mm bore because 80 mm cannot provide the 40.25 kN cutting-load case below 70 bar. A 50 mm rod gives annulus area about 58.90 cm2, making retract speed sufficient with the selected pump. Pump delivery with 19 cm3/rev at 1500 rpm and 0.90 volumetric efficiency is 25.65 L/min. This gives approach speed 25.65*10/78.54 = 3.266 m/min and retract speed 25.65*10/58.90 = 4.354 m/min. Relief-limited available extend force is about 49.48 kN and retract force about 37.11 kN at 70 bar and 0.90 cylinder mechanical efficiency. The pressure-compensated rod-end meter-out feed control is adjustable over 2.945 to 5.890 L/min, corresponding to 0.5 to 1.0 m/min. Hydraulic power at 70 bar and 25.65 L/min is about 2.99 kW; divided by 0.85 gives about 3.52 kW, so the next IEC motor is 4 kW. Reservoir is about 3 times pump flow, so 80 L is selected. Maximum DCV flow is cap-end exhaust on retract, about 34.2 L/min; 1.25 times this is below the 60 L/min NG6 rating.

selected.approach: Smallest evaluated design that proves all criteria: keep the clamp at the smaller preferred bore but step the working cylinder up so the standard pump does not exceed the working-advance speed band.

actuator_decisions.justification: Clamp extend and clamp hold are the clamp load cases. Tool chain: required area 4761.9 mm2, preferred bore 80 mm with cap area 5026.5 mm2, conventional rod 45 mm with annulus area 3436.1 mm2 and area ratio 1.463.

Working advance is the loaded working-actuator phase. Tool chain: required area 7936.5 mm2, preferred bore 125 mm with cap area 12271.8 mm2, conventional rod 70 mm with annulus area 8423.4 mm2 and area ratio 1.457.

supply_decision.justification: Working advance is the only phase with a specified speed. Tool chain: flow at 3 m/min is 36.815 L/min, standard pump displacement 28.0 cm3/rev delivers 37.8 L/min, motor shaft power at 70 bar is 5.188 kW with a 5.5 kW rating, and NG6 directional-valve rating is 60.0 L/min.

setting_decisions.basis: Set at the global pressure ceiling while clearing verified working pressures; evaluation proved all pressure criteria.
Set at the clamp branch pressure ceiling that put the reducing valve in the circuit.
Set at the same clamp branch ceiling so release-side supply is also pressure-limited.
Coordinated with the clamp force proof point and below the clamp pressure-reducer and relief settings.
Above normal work-retract pressure and below relief so clamp release waits until work retraction reaches end position.

engineering_notes: Evaluation verdict: PROVED, with 7 criteria proved and none undecided or refuted.

Evaluation operating point for clamp extend: flow-limited, velocity 7.520071061092056 m/min, pump pressure 40.0 bar, supply pressure 26.58446292029816 bar, exhaust pressure 0.08578058481216433 bar, no relief flow, feasible true.

Evaluation operating point for working advance: flow-limited, velocity 3.080221106623306 m/min, pump pressure 27.85405990036124 bar, supply pressure 27.25870990036124 bar, exhaust pressure 0.14024807596799999 bar, no relief flow, feasible true.
No rod area-ratio strategy is used because the fixed topology has no fixed metering orifice required to create two different speeds in the same direction.
A smaller 100 mm working-cylinder option was evaluated but did not prove the working-advance velocity band; it achieved [3.193, 3.338] m/min against the required 2.7 .. 3.3 m/min.
open_issues: Commission the actual sequence-valve settings after installed valve and line losses are measured.

selected.approach: Smallest evaluated arrangement that proves all acceptance criteria: compact clamp cylinder, enlarged preferred working cylinder to bring standard-pump working speed inside the band, conventional rods, and low practical relief setting.

actuator_decisions.justification: Clamp extend and hold have the same 12 kN governing force under the 40 bar clamp branch ceiling; sizing near the useful upper part of that ceiling gives the smallest preferred clamp bore.

Working advance is the only 30 kN working-cylinder force duty. Sizing at this lower pressure selects the next preferred bore and avoids the verified high-side velocity uncertainty of the more compact 100 mm working bore.

supply_decision.justification: Working advance is the only phase with a stated speed requirement and governs pump delivery. The evaluated result proves the speed band with the standard pump selected from this bore/flow choice.

setting_decisions.basis: Clears verified working pressures and the reverse-sequence setting while remaining below the 70 bar system ceiling.
Set at the clamp branch pressure ceiling.
Set at the same clamp branch pressure ceiling so clamp release is also protected.
Below the clamp reducing setting and above approach pressure so working advance starts only after clamp pressure is established.
Above normal unloaded work-retract pressure and below relief so clamp release waits for retraction end-stop pressure rise.

Tool sizing results: WorkCylinder at 42 bar requires 7936.5 mm2 and selects 125 mm bore, 12271.8 mm2 cap area, 70 mm rod, 8423.4 mm2 annulus area, and 1.457 cap-to-annulus ratio.

With 50 bar used for the checked power point, shaft power is 3.706 kW and the standard motor rating is 4.0 kW. Directional valve selection at 37.8 L/min with margin is NG6 rated 60.0 L/min.

selected.approach: Proven low-pressure-exposure strategy: keep the minimum clamp cylinder, deliberately use the next larger working cylinder for speed compatibility, and lower the relief/sequence settings.

actuator_decisions.justification: Clamp extend and hold govern. Tool selection gave bore 80 mm, cap area 5026.5 mm2, rod 45 mm, annulus area 3436.1 mm2.

A lower design pressure intentionally selects the larger working bore to satisfy force with margin and make the standard pump step fall inside the accepted speed band. Tool selection gave bore 125 mm, cap area 12271.8 mm2, rod 70 mm, annulus area 8423.4 mm2.

supply_decision.justification: Tool flow for the larger work-cylinder cap area at the stated working-advance speed was 36.815 L/min; the standard pump selected was 28.0 cm3/rev delivering 37.8 L/min. Motor tool result at 55 bar was 4.076 kW shaft power and 5.5 kW motor rating; valve tool result was NG6 rated 60.0 L/min.
